description: The Chapter 5 READINESS release includes Python graph-edit-distance functions, graph comparison code and a graph-based system library. The native description specifies an algorithm that creates connections between systems and a small library that recreates dissertation graphs. Excel contains system and connection attributes. Outputs represent diesel generators and methanol dual-fuel generators with ballast-tank systems and an alternative methanol-diesel ratio. Graph visualisation outputs accompany the configured algorithm; they are not treated as another independent resource.
